name: crown-of-football
description: CROWN OF FOOTBALL — a browser-based football club management and match simulation game by Hamid Yarali.
author: Hamid Yarali (https://github.com/HamidYaraliOfficial)

scripts.dev:full: concurrently -k -n WEB,API -c green,blue "npm run dev --workspace @crown-of-football/web" "npm run start:dev --workspace @crown-of-football/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @crown-of-football/web && npm run build --workspace @crown-of-football/api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @crown-of-football/web && npm run test --workspace @crown-of-football/api
